headline: Mjällby favourites in Tbilisi despite 8 games without a win
summary: Mjällby AIF are the favourites for their Conference League trip to Tbilisi even though they have gone 8 Allsvenskan games without a win. Tom Pettersson told SVT Sport the slump makes the trip to Georgia hard. What holds them up is the chances: 1.42 expected goals a game. Iberia created only 0.15 expected goals in their opener, but they won 2-0 at Dila on Sunday. On the market average, Mjällby's chance has slipped from 41.8% to 39.7%, and the sides are rated just 0.16 goals apart. The goal line is 2.5, with the over at 50%.
read: Mjällby are the favourites for Thursday's trip to Tbilisi at 39.7%, but they arrive eight Allsvenskan games without a win and their price has drifted from 41.8% in the last day. The market rates the sides barely a quarter of a goal apart, with the goal line dead level at 2.5 and Iberia's home win at 31.3%.

facts.fact: Mjällby are the favourites to win in Tbilisi at 39.7%, against Iberia's 31.3%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the travelling side the more likely winner even though it is Iberia who are at home.

facts.fact: Mjällby have gone eight straight Allsvenskan matches without a win.
facts.meaning: Their league season is sliding at the same time as their European campaign has started well.

facts.fact: Tom Pettersson said in a direct quote that he is not "in the mood" to travel to Georgia given the team's situation.
facts.meaning: The mood around the Mjällby camp is low going into a long trip.

facts.fact: Mjällby's chance of winning has drifted from 41.8% to 39.7% in the past day, with the home price shortening at the same time.
facts.meaning: Support arrived for Iberia rather than the favourite in the final build-up.

facts.fact: Across their last five matches Mjällby averaged 1.42 xG for and 1.02 against, yet won only one of them.
facts.meaning: They are still creating more than they concede; the results, not the chances, are the problem.

facts.fact: The market rates the two sides almost level, with the fair handicap line at just +0.16 goals to Iberia and the main line at +0.25.
The goal line is 2.5 and it is dead level, over and under both priced at 50.0%.
facts.meaning: The market sees an even, unremarkable goal game with no lean either way.

facts.fact: Iberia created just 0.15 xG in their Conference League opener at St. Truiden, which they lost.
facts.meaning: At this level they have so far produced almost no attacking threat.

sources.fact: The match will be played at the Mikheil Meskhi stadium in Tbilisi and streamed on Disney+ with an 18:45 local kick-off on Thursday 22 October.
Mjällby have gone eight straight Allsvenskan matches without a win while also playing in Europe.
Mjällby lost 0-1 away to Västerås SK, with a goal for them disallowed.
Tom Pettersson said in a direct quote that right now he is not "in the mood" to travel to Georgia given the team's situation.
Mjällby won their first ever match in a European main tournament, beating Inter Club d'Escaldes 2-0 with goals from Jacob Bergström and Axel Norén.
Coach Andreas Brännström said after the 2-0 win over Inter Club d'Escaldes that it was very important to win.
Anders Torstensson is identified by Cambio de banda as the coach who led Mjällby in 2025.
